scope.coupling: Finite particle-body attachments connect cloth and free rigid; other objects independently contact the plane
scope.default_alm_semantics: Finite-material rod compliant ALM only; persistent numeric duals and Dahl history are explicit state
scope.official_coverage: Active encoder has one official demo plus five-type custom mixed training, not historical ten-demo neural coverage.
scope.material_damping: Objective C-rate tet/membrane and dihedral bending
scope.teacher_target: Same refined transfer and legacy replay manifest as v16; no default-budget rod labels added.
scope.prescribed_boundaries: Original step controls; explicit fixed-entity-only input arrays for training, original controller for native inference
scope.backward: Frozen physical H and physical coarse Q; scalar encoder and factor gradients are retained. Not an exact full-physics derivative.
scope.bending_coarse: Six intrinsic bending modes on detected planar grids with a fully pinned edge; other geometries keep general modes
scope.collective_predictor: Mass-projected existing velocity transported along guarded bending arcs; no future state or added dynamic solve
scope.state_positions: COM for legacy scenes; authored origin poses for history rod scenes
scope.training_curriculum: Shared encoder/context warm-started from v18; directional shapes and scalar gate zero initialized. No old rigid shape head retained.
scope.closed_ring_modes: Six geometry-derived shear-null bending/twist modes plus exact current rigid modes; per-component trust and mass-metric separation. No extra neural parameters.
scope.closed_ring_velocity: One guarded mass-metric projection of current coarse velocity before K=4 force updates; no reference state
scope.cyclic_validation: Declare 2-second free-ring covariance-spectrum validation before training; retain raw world pose loss and use original full-duration task check independently
scope.operator_probe: Calibrate already trained shared weights with refined complete transfer episodes and previous coupled/plane replay. No new demos claimed.
scope.validation_scope: Four predeclared 0.2s transfer windows cover startup, ramp end, hold and terminal phases; 12 single-step checks span the full validation episode. Full autoregressive tasks and held-out material are separate.
scope.protected_response: Six directional proposal/propagation/velocity columns, per-column inverse-metric scaling, rank mask and shared projected inverse gate.
scope.factor_budget: At most 6x6 projected inverse solves and local factors; physical Q has at most 12 columns. No global dynamics matrix or convergence loop.
scope.experimental_comparison: Sequential architecture development with a warm start, not a matched-total-training-budget architecture comparison.
scope.acceptance: Prototype experiment, not the default or all-demo accepted model.
scope.input_normalization: Material energy divided by local mobile mass times L^2/dt^2; inverse conditioning already dimensionless because W=h M^-1/2. Inactive numerical padding excluded. Encoding covariance is separate from whole-solver covariance.
scope.validation_selection: Each object endpoint/window score may increase at most 5% of max(initial score,1e-4); select balanced normalized mean only among admissible candidates. Fixed before optimizer updates.
scope.physical_vector_control: Same six vector columns with unit shapes and prescribed near-unit metric gate, no NN calls. Compare separately from zero-gate physical baseline.
scope.test_isolation: Material1.17 is development after v18. Newly frozen material1.33 is excluded from training/selection and model evaluation until weights are selected.
